articleTitle: Research and design of automatic control system for central air conditioning in building automatic network system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Automatic control system for buildings consists of many subsystems such as, heating and ventilation, fire protection, elevator, cold/hot water supply, Security and access control, power distribution and monitoring, parking management etc. In the paper, the water circulating subsystem and air conditioning units monitoring and control subsystem are treated as a central air-conditioning automatic control system, and ultimately, in accordance with MODBUS RTU or Profibus protocol, are integrated into the overall building automation system to solve the network communication problems in the building automation network due to the inconsistency of subsystem equipment by different manufacturers.

articleTitle: The dynamic modelling and simulation of planar flexible multibody systems based on vector bond graph
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: For the dynamic modelling and simulation of planar flexible multibody sysytems containing electromechanical coupling, the corresponding vector bond graph method was proposed. Based on the kinematic relationship of planar flexible multibody systems, the general procedure for modelling planar flexible multibody systems by vector bond graph is described. The constraint force vectors at joints can be considered as unknown effort source vectors and added to the corresponding 0-junctions of the system vector bond graph model, the differential causality in system vector bond graph model can be eliminated completely or mostly. As a result, the unified modelling and simulation for planar flexible multiybody containing electromechanical coupling is realized. The validity of proposed method is illustrated by a practical example.

articleTitle: Direction and polarization estimation using quaternion and polarization rotation matrix
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Estimation of directions-of-arrival (DOAs) and polarization parameters of incident signals needs a high-dimensional searching process with long-vector methods, which results in tremendous computational load. To overcome this disadvantage, this paper proposes a novel algorithm using quaternion and polarization rotation matrix on the basis of a uniform circular array (UCA) which is composed of cocenterd orthogonal loop and dipole (COLD) pairs. First, a quaternion mode is set and polarization parameters are separated from the array manifold. Then, DOA parameters are acquired using a two-dimensional searching process. Meanwhile, based on long-vector mode, a polarization rotation matrix is constructed, and closed-form estimation of polarization parameters is obtained. The presented algorithm has a large reduction in computational effort and an obvious improvement in precision for DOA estimation under low signal-to-noise (SNR) ratio. The effectiveness is confirmed through computer simulation.

articleTitle: Generation of basic emotions for virtual human in the virtual environment
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Will it become more natural and believable if a virtual human has emotions like a real human? The answer must be YES. This paper studies a method to simulate human's basic emotions according to Basic Emotion Theory and Cognitive Evaluation Theory in Psychology, based on Fuzzy Rules. At first, `emotion factor' is generated according to the emotion elicited rules based on Fuzzy IF-THEN rules. Then the emotion intensity is computed by a nonlinear function restricted by personality, emotion factor and emotion state at the previous moment. The simulation by MATLAB shows, this method can simulate the fuzzy and nonlinear characteristic of human emotion to a certain extent. The method is also applied in a virtual human, who looks like full of emotions and act as a real human.

articleTitle: The establishment and strategy of digital identity authentication system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Hundreds of millions of webusers access to or use a variety of network services via various digital identity credentials every day. Network security issues such as Identity authentication, privacy and information sharing have become focuses of IT industry. To strengthen network security management and risk prevention, some of China's large-scale sites have launched real name registration policy, indicating that digital identity gradually stepping into normalization. This paper intends to explore ways of encouraging the establishment of digital identity authentication system.

articleTitle: Researches on time managing technology based on frame wall controls
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: The wall clock control time manage tactics is proposed on this paper, make simulation system guarantee events can be carried out at each federal member in correct order, and emulation advanced time is roughly the same as frame wall, which meets systemic requirement of real-time in half material emulation, have realized expanded real-time data processing and disposing after the event.

articleTitle: A low-complexity algorithm for decoding of M-ary LDPC codes
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: M-ary LDPC codes provide higher performances than their binary counterpart but suffer from highest decoding complexity. The use of stochastic decoding algorithm can reduce the decoding complexity, but the computational complexity of probability generation is very high. A simple method to fast generate the probability especially in high-order modulation schemes is proposed in this paper. Simulation results show the proposed algorithm causes negligible performance degradation with reduction in computational complexity, which gives some advantages in hardware implementation of the decoders.

articleTitle: The problem on f -coloring of all generalized petersen graphs
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: An f-coloring of a graph G is a coloring of edges of E(G) such that each color appears at each vertex v ∈ V (G) at most f (v) times. The minimum number of colors needed to f-color G is called the f-chromatic index of G, and denoted by χ′f(G). Any graph G has f -chromatic index equal to Δf (G) or Δf (G)+1, where equation. If χ′f(G) = Δf(G), then G is of Cf 1; otherwise G is of Cf 2. The f -core of G is the subgraph of G induced by the vertices of equation. In this paper some results about the generalized Petersen graphs are presented.

articleTitle: Research on management pattern of enterprise based on e-commerce
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: This paper introduces the concept and main features of enterprise information resources management, analyzes the current situation of enterprises in the electronic business environment, and discusses the problems of strategic planning and organizational structure of enterprise information resources management in the electronic business environment. Then, it describes several common patterns of different types of enterprises in the process of information resource management in the business environment, and does some related analysis. Meanwhile, on this basis it provides the enterprise information resource management system including three parts which are the functional structure, technical structure and network structure. Based on the model system, it will integrate the information resource management and electronic business, highlighting the management of enterprise information resources. In the end, it builds and analyses enterprise information resource management model on the basis of electronic business. At the same time, it introduces enterprise information resources sharing under different circumstances, and the ways to facilitate the implementation of enterprise knowledge innovation.

articleTitle: The hierarchical resource management model based on cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: In order to resolve the heavy load and the long waiting time in the centralize resource management, we bring new better model, which is the hierarchical resource management model based on resource tables. This paper describes the model of hierarchical management system and the process of the resource allocation; giving the form of the resource table in this model and the access control policy of the resource table.

articleTitle: Table of contents
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Presents the table of contents of the proceedings.

articleTitle: [Front and back cover]
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Presents the front and back cover or splash screen of the proceedings record.

articleTitle: A wheel treads flat detection system for high-speed railway
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: The state of wheel tread is related to the safety of train operation, detecting the train wheel tread abrasion conditions is great significant for ensuring the safe operation of trains. This thesis researched the detection method of wheel tread flat of domestic and abroad, and researched a method based on flat wheel and rail impact, the data has been wave filtered and unified standard. Finally, the results of detection system and experimental result are compared, proved the reliability and feasibility of detection methods, indicated that the detection system has a certain reference value.

articleTitle: NN-based fuel injection control system for hybrid fuel engine
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: It is proposed particularly that a self-turning fuel injection control system on integrating Neural Network and self-turning control. The system is suitable for the control of engine that gasoline is as fuel, and meets with the diversified the request of air-fuel ratio in different working condition. The system is also applicable to the control of engine that gasoline and methanol is compounded as fuel, and is flexible to specify the objective air- fuel ratio in meeting with the different mixture ratio of gasoline and methanol. It can achieve the request that the objective air-fuel ratio is arbitrary continuous to be specified in certain scope. The result of experiment indicates that the system has better self-applicability, robustness and speediness. Moreover, the system not only overcome the diversified error from manufacturing, wearing and parameter changing, but also structure is simple, memory is occupied less, on-line train time is short, computation speed is fast, learn capacity is strong and the object specified value of system is by zero error tracking.

articleTitle: A new notion of strong-precompactness in L-topological spaces
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: In this paper, the concept of strong-precompactness is introduced in L-topological spaces by means of strongly preopen L-sets and their inequality, where L is a complete De Morgan algebra. The new concept does not depend on the structure of basis lattice L which does not require any distributivity. Some fundamental properties of strong-precompactness are obtained. Especially, when L is a completely distributive De Morgan algebra, its many characterizations are presented.

articleTitle: Fuzzy model optimization based on cooperative evolutionary genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Interpretability and accuracy are base requirements of fuzzy model. An approach to construct fuzzy model based on co-evolutionary genetic algorithm is proposed for the requirements. First, the initial fuzzy system is identified using WM method because of its simplicity and quickness to generate fuzzy rules. The membership functions and fuzzy rule base are optimized by the co-evolutionary genetic algorithm in order to improve accuracy of the fuzzy model. The result of simulation experiment shows its validity.

articleTitle: Study on the comparison between MIMO and phased array antenna
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: By comparing the principle of phased array antenna (PAA) with that of MIMO (Multiple-Input Multiple-Output), it could be found that there are full of inter-contradictions between MIMO and PAA theories. According to Shannon formula, each independent Rayleigh fading channel (IRFC) is determined by the bandwidth and the carrier frequency, or spectrum. In the PAA systems, though all signals are transmitted with the same carrier frequency, some IRFCs still could be achieved by the space division multiplexing (SDM). However the IRFC constructed by each pair of the transmitting and receiving antennas in MIMO systems only could be defined as a virtual IRFC (VIRFC) since the PAA technique is not used in the systems. Moreover, these VIRFCs are almost impossible to be transformed to IRFCs in receiver. Due to the existing of VIRFCs and the non-using of PAA technique, the transmitting beam without required direction would be introduced in MIMO syutem. In consequence, many blind spots of radio coverage and an unreasonable wireless communication system would be formed. It would be pointed out in the paper that the definition of IRFC in MIMO theory is inappropriate, which makes the channel capacity derived by MIMO theory in mathematics is difficult to be achieved in implementations.

articleTitle: 3D FEM calculation of Lorentz force field in 300 kA aluminum electrolysis cells
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: The mathematical models of the 300 kA Al electrolysis cell are established by ANSYS for the Lorentz force field calculation. The results show the Lorentz force density (LFD) located the interface of melt in X, Y, Z direction varied almost from -100 to 100 N/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, from -200 to 200 N/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, and from -200 to 200 N/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, respectively. The LFD located the liquid Al in X, Y, Z direction varied from -100 to 100 N/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, from -200 to 200 N/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, and from -400 to 400 N/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, respectively. The LFD located the electrolyte in X, Y, Z direction varied from -1000 to 1000 N/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, from -5000 to 5000 N/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, and from -1000 to 1000 N/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, respectively. It reveals the instability is governed by the distribution pattern of the vertical component of the magnetic field. An alteration to a prototype 300 kA cell bus configuration led to an improvement in pad stability. The calculation of Lorentz force field gives a significant reference on the optimization design of the Al electrolysis cell.

articleTitle: Scientific design on teachers'performance evaluation index and weight of vocational colleges
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Besides four general evaluation index of “morality, ability, attendance and achievement”, bonus items are added to more fairly and objectively evaluate vocational teachers' comprehensive contribution to specialty and college. AHP and ANP are adopted to design weight to better solve the problem of merely using AHP to determine weight index. So the weight will be designed more scientifically and reasonably.

articleTitle: Microscopic image restoration of Chinese herbal medicine based on blind deconvolution algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Microscopic image acquisition process of Chinese herbal medicine (CHM) could be affected by the influence of the different conditions, such as CHM samples defiled, microscopic producer of mobile, collection site light not equal, this often make microscopic images of CHM for become blurred or introducing noise. In this paper, microscopic images of CHM are blurred using blind deconvolution algorithm (BDA) combined with the related filter in the case of the point spread function is unknown or uncertain. Experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively perform blind image restoration, maintained good image detail, the recovery is more effective than traditional BDA, and provide a guarantee to its subsequent processing.

articleTitle: Galerkin method for the problem of purely longitudinal motion of a homogeneous bar
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: In this paper, the Galerkin method for the initial-boundary-value problem of purely longitudinal motion equation of a homogeneous bar is analyzed. Optimal order error estimates for the approximations of displacement are obtained. At last,a numerical example is provided to validate the theoretical analysis.

Author Keywords: Purely longitudinal motion of homogeneous bar

articleTitle: Design of automatic hot-dip galvanizing device for small components based on solid edge
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: In this paper, a kind of automatic hot-dip galvanizing device for small components is design in order to solve the problem of highly dependence on complex artificial operations with labor intensive and difficult control of the coating often encountered during the production process of the hot-dip galvanizing in the past. By comparing and analyzing two different design schemes of mechanisms, a better scheme is obtained. A three dimensional model was made and the corresponding motion was simulated in the design of automatic hot galvanizing device with assistance of the software Solid Edge. It is found that the device can make a continuous hot-dip galvanizing for the varieties of small components.

articleTitle: Implementing java programming language on RTEMS operating system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: This work make Java programming language work on RTEMS operating system. We select the GNU Java solution for this implementation. And make the three part of GCJ be supported on RTEMS, boehm-gc, libffi and libjava. Link with RTEMS and debug with gdb, then give out the test results of the implementation.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization based on clonal selection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-objective optimization based on clonal selection algorithm. The use of cloning and mutation operators can promote the local and global searching performance. Adopting the non-uniform mutation operator can improve the searching for optimal solutions in the local region and assure the diversity of the solutions. At the same time, multiple cloning which is based on crowding distance is proposed to promote the diversity of the population. External archive is set to store the non-dominated solutions and crowding distance and delete operator are combined to complete the update of the external archive. Final results show that the proposed approach's performances are better than those proposed by NSGA-II. It gets a closer Pareto curve which is a set of the uniform and widespread solution.

articleTitle: Stabilization control of chaotic motions in thruster motor for deepwater robot
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: in this paper, an adaptive control technique is applied to controlling the chaotic behavior in thruster motor system for deepwater robot. This chaotic oscillation has a direct impact on the stability, reliability and security of the robot. In addition, the proposed approach is also verified in the way of both flexibility and effectiveness, and a kind of chaotic controller that is applicable for manufacturing is designed and constructed. The simulation results show that thruster motor system can escape from the chaotic state in a short time by using the adaptive controller and transfer into continuous stable state. The method presented has improved performance of the control system obviously.

articleTitle: Research of accident characteristics of coalmine safety based on cluster analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: The article applied ward cluster analysis method in features of coalmine safety accident. Based on data to frequency and casualty of coalmine accident in 2004-2010 years, Coalmine disaster accident is divided to six regions: southwest china, south of the Yangtze River, northeast, north china, ningxia-shaanxi-Inner Mongolia and northwest china. Gas accidents and roof accidents are main type of coalmine accident, where is southwest and south of the Yangtze River of China. Results show that use cluster analysis to coalmine disaster region division is feasible and some important guiding significance.

articleTitle: A particle swarm optimization algorithm for hybrid wireless sensor networks coverage
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: To optimizing the coverage performance of sensor network with random deployment, this paper proposed a strategy which is based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) with dynamic clone. The algorithm control clone number and variation range of particles, which represents the positions of all mobile sensor nodes, on the base of classical particle swarm algorithm, according to their coverage rate and similarity among the swarms, the particles decide the clone number and variation scope after each iteration completing, and avoid being trapped in early-maturing situation. The result of simulation shows that this optimized algorithm is able to greatly improve the coverage of the network than other compared algorithms.

articleTitle: Study on SoftMan mobile system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Traditional mobile system adopted centralized management manner and maintenance is complex. JXTA is a new technique coexisted with Client/Server computation mode. A kind of mobile SoftMan system based on JXTA is put forward in this paper. At first, it is compared with traditional mobile agent system, and then SoftMan mobile system architecture is analyzed and information transmission, reception and transaction are introduced in detail. At last, SoftMan implementation is expounded. Mobile SoftMan system based on JXTA is more agile and simpler than traditional mobile system.

articleTitle: Numerical investigation of hydrodynamics of flapping caudal fin
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: This paper investigates the hydrodynamic performance of flapping caudal fin by means of numerical simulation. Dynamic simulations of caudal fin with heaving and pitching motion are conducted to determine the relationship between the maximum angle of attack and difference of phase angle in terms of thrust coefficient and propulsive efficiency under low frequency. Combing 20°~30°maximum angle of attack with 70°~90° difference of phase angle, outstanding propulsive efficiency can be obtained. In addition, qualitative analyses are made to the wake vortex spacing. This study shows that wake spacing has interaction with the thrust coefficient and the propulsive efficiency.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis of back body of TH65100 horizontal machining center based on finite element
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: The main content of this paper is dynamic analysis and the improved structure of back body of TH65100 horizontal machining center. The boundary conditions are established and the structure of back body is studied by finite element modal analysis. The results indicate back body has the disfigurement that torsional rigidity is not enough. The improved scheme is presented which aim at the disfigurement of structure of back body and the improved structure is testified. The main disfigurement of structure of back body is improved is this scheme which enhance the economical efficiency of the manufacture of back body.

articleTitle: Query aggregation algorithm in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Aiming at queries with SQL-like language, this paper proposes a queries aggregation algorithm in order to adapt the limitation of Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) resource. According to the attribute historic data stored on the base station, the algorithm calculates the energy cost of queries before and after the aggregation. If the cost falls off after the aggregation, the queries will be aggregated into a new one. Simulation results show that the algorithm can reduce the number of queries in WSN, avoid large amount of redundant data transmission and effectively save the energy consumption.

articleTitle: Design of the remaining battery measurement system with the DS2781 chip
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: This paper is based on WIA-PA industrial wireless network as the background, it introduces the basic function of DS2781 chip and its technical characteristics, and uses 1-wire bus technology to the design of the remaining battery capacity measuring system, and then it introduces the hardware structure of the system. Finally we use IAR platform to preparation of procedures to measure the battery remaining power.

articleTitle: A neural network model of a fuel cell stack under road vibrations
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: A model is very important for studying the dynamic response of the fuel cell stack under road vibrations. Mechanism models have many parameters which can't be measured in real stack tests when the outside forces and the inside parameters are all needed to be known. The fuel cell stack used in new energy car which takes place of conventional engine is a complicated nonlinear mechanical system. while its durability under vibration is tested, only the driving and responding signals are collected. In this case, a neural network is used to predict the response of the stack under different vibration conditions and also to be used as a fault diagnose tool.

articleTitle: Analysis and simulation of the updating cost of group key management scheme in ad hoc network
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Tree-based and star-based key management schemes have being widely used in ad hoc network. In this paper, we use the Discrete-Time Markov Chain (DTMC) to simulate the dynamic environment when group members join and leave. And we also analyze the updating cost of the tree-based and star-based structure. The analysis results show that the probability and velocity of members leaving dominate the relative performance between the two schemes. Therefore, we propose to use an adaptive key management scheme according to star-based scheme and canonical-tree-based scheme.

articleTitle: The Simulation and experiment research on new portable compressor
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: The new portable compressor was designed and manufactured. Volume and its weight of The new portable compressor are little, and its efficiency is high. Three-dimensional model of the new portable compressor is Established. Forces principle of air compressor and load moment are analysised. The measure reciprocating inertial force of the new portable compressor is analysised and Controlled. Simulation Model of The new portable compressor is built up in Simulink of Matlab. Rotate speed of two compressor and current of two compressor are Simulated. The Current of opposed type is much more than that of contraposition type. The half of horizontal reciprocating inertial force is transferred to the perpendicularity, which can reduce the vibration horizontal vibration, so that reduce the vibration of the direct-drive air compressor. The test is done. The result shows that rotate speed fluctuate of dual- same movement pistons compressor is less. The efficiency of opposed type compressor is much higher than that of dual- same compressor.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of aero-engine based on information entropy and symbolization
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Using information entropy can measure of the disorder degree of the source system to discussing its application in the aero-engine performance evaluation, combined with the symbolization processing of time series. In the extraction of entropy, directly extracting the joint entropy aimed at the symbolic series of multiple performance parameters, and extracting the entropy aimed at the short-symbol series which reconstruction single parameter to generate short-symbol series, were used respectively. Experiments of actual flight data have been done, and the results shows that the two characteristic indicator of information entropy described in the healthy evolution of aero-engine coincide with the actual situation. The methods can reflect the health condition, and can support the performance evaluation of aero-engine.

articleTitle: Computation for exponential matrix via restrictive pade approximation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: By following the definition of a restrictive Pade approximation (RPA), some algebraic properties are discussed. The determinantal expression of exponential function via RPA is given.

articleTitle: One model for Grid resource management based on deployment
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: In order to help endusers to manage their concerned resources easily in Grid system, one model based on deployment is proposed in this paper. By introducing deployment idea and related operations, our model can find out all the required ones from numerous resources in Grid system according to endusers' requirements. Under this model, one uniform management operation for resources is designed to provide transparent management so that endusers are shielded from the complicated details, and free to concentrate on their domain science.

articleTitle: Application of EFGM-FEM coupling analysis for retaining wall
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Numerical model of Element Free Galerkin Method (EFGM) coupling Finite Element Method (FEM) for retaining wall is proposed. Concrete was calculated by EFGM and reinforcement was simulated by truss elements in FEM. The stiffness matrix of the whole structure was gained based on displacement compatibility condition. Via analyzing one RC retaining wall, the calculation shows that the method is feasible.

articleTitle: The application of photoelectric sensor in strip's center position control and rectification system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: This paper presents strip's center position control and rectification system based on photoelectric sensor. The system chooses fluorescent lamp as signal light source, designs corresponding optical signal conversion and processing circuit, adopts Single Chip Micyoco (SCM) to process received detection signals, and writes corresponding modulation software. Drift measurement was done in the lab and the results proved that the system has excellent repeatability, linearity, and accuracy, and is of certain practical value in actual strip production line system.

articleTitle: PC virtual assembly system based on the VRML/X3D
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: In the teaching of computer maintenance, using the traditional teaching tools is difficult to teach demonstration of computer assembly, and experimental assembly supplies loss is very serious. Therefore, the author did some research of the Web in 3D virtual environment virtual interactive operation technology. Built a PC virtual assembly system on VRML/X3D, 3DS MAX and ASP. More users can remotely view from a different angle of computer accessories and install computer. A clearer understanding of the PC accessories and installation is shown.

articleTitle: A virtual instruments -based visualization of fault diagnosis method
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Combining with virtual instrument technology and fault diagnosis techniques, a visualized fault diagnosis system based on virtual instrument was established under the VR environment. Firstly, the implementation of virtual instrument and the construction method of some relevant static and dynamic components were put forward. Secondly the simulation on the fault diagnosis process was accomplished by means of knowledge-based visualized component. Then the fault symptoms was displayed through virtual instrument and the diagnosis was more directly perceived through fault diagnosis training with operation. Finally, avisualized fault diagnosis was conducted through taking aircraft air condition system as an example, the actual fault detection and removed process was simulated and the intended goal was achieved.

articleTitle: Linear precoding design based on distortion channel estimate in MIMO relay system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: A linear relay precoding design scheme is proposed based on distortion channel estimation in the amplify-and-forward MIMO relay system, this sheme modeles the channel estimation errors as Gaussian random variables. The closed-form solution is derived according to the minimum mean squared error (MMSE) criterion. The numerical simulation results show that comparing with other schemes that do not consider channel estimation errors, this scheme achieves better performance in terms of both mean squared error (MSE) and bit error rate (BER).

articleTitle: Design of intelligent power supply based on cortex-M3
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: In this paper, a NC stabilized power based on STM32F103VCT6 is designed. The power outputs the analog quantity through the D/A converter in the output of microprocessor. Then it is isolated and amplified by an operational amplifier, and controls the base of the output power tube. Different voltage is output as the base voltage of the power tube varies. The output voltage controlled by the keyboard can realize the stepping of 0.1V, and the value of voltage output is displayed by LCD in real time. In the implementation procedure, the functions like error correction, fault self-diagnosis, over-current and overvoltage protection are also taken into consideration, which is much more practical. The actual test result shows that the power is adjustable and practical in actual application with wide output range, small ripple and strong anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: An Extended Euclid Algorithm for Rational Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Let n/d∈Q,m be a positive integer and Let u=n/d mod m. Thus u is the image of a rational number modulo m. The rational reconstruction problem is: given u and m find n/d. Classical Euclidean Algorithm outputs n/d when m>;2M2, where M=max(|n|,d). The rational reconstruction problem was generally solved by classical Euclidean algorithm. In this paper, we achieve an Extended Euclidean algorithm for rational, and obtain an solvability criterion, hence, the number of solutions. Its Computational complexity is O(mlog2mloglogm).

articleTitle: Armored materiel warehouse logistics capability maturity model based on ANN
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Maturity model is applied in armored materiel warehouse logistics capability appraisal, an armored materiel warehouse logistics capability maturity model based on ANN is proposed and the logistics capability appraisal indexes are set up. The treatment method of “the dimensional analysis plus main composition analysis” is adopted in the input index and “GA-AHP plus collecting value statistics” is adopted in the output index. The model is also applied for other type warehouse logistics capability appraisal.

articleTitle: GM-PSO based dynamically forecasting and compensation of liquid steel temperature
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Accurately forecasting the temperature of liquid steel directly affects the quality of steel and continuous casting operation. To solve the problem of real time temperature forecasting and compensation of dynamic liquid steel temperature measuring system, a forecasting model based on the over-damped second-order system theory is developed applying the collected raw data of the liquid steel's temperature, in which a grey model based particle swarm optimization (GM-PSO) is presented for solving both the small size samples problem of the raw data and excluding the unreliable data. Then both the raw data and the generated data are employed to conduct the model parameter identification. Simulation results show that the proposed method performance better than the traditional genetic algorithms based ones in considerably improving both the forecasting accuracy for small sample and compensation accuracy.

articleTitle: Constructing simulation scenario based-on ontology
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Constructing simulation scenario domain ontology is an important means in the repetitive use and mutual operation of simulation scenario domain modeling. This paper suggests an appropriate SS-Onto construction method on the basis of the advantages possessed by ontology and the studies already done in this field. The paper will serve as a foundation for the further construction of SS-Onto (semi-) automation and the application of ontology.

articleTitle: Development of software of the pulse wave data analysis and management system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: In order to more conveniently and efficiently manage pulse wave collected in clinical, designed a friendly interface of human-computer interaction system to automatically analyze the descriptive parameters of pulse wave, recognize the types of pulse waves based on the BP network, and establish a database to help users manage the pulse wave data. The software design is realized by using MATLAB. Includes five functional modules-data acquisition, data analysis and processing, the recognition for the types of pulse waves based on the BP neural network, pulse wave database and help file. Finally, in order to verify the performance of the software design, use the system to collect and analyze the data of pulse wave of 40 subjects in clinical.

articleTitle: Research on warship main power plant on board training system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: on board training system has realistic training environment, effective, low cost, safety, ease of implementation and many other advantages, it becomes an important development direction of ship simulation training system. This paper Investigate the Research state of on board training system from home and abroad, combines the latest ship automation research Achievement, researches the critical technology of warship main power plant on board training system, proposed hybrid modeling method based on neural network, uses CompactRIO embedded system to embed on board training system in the warship main power plant monitoring network with CAN bus and Ethernet network.

articleTitle: Construction of individual user space for Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: As Cloud services proliferate, it is confused for users to find and consume services that they need. For one user in a particular area, most frequently used services are usually fixed and do not change often. As a result it is necessary for users to construct individual user space under Cloud Computing, where frequently used services are deployed. In this paper, we present a framework to build a user space in which users are able to select, deploy and undeploy a service and establish a new service through services composition. So users can always work in “small and feat” user space avoiding being lost among numerous services in Clouds.

articleTitle: Construction method of a distributed agriculture search engine
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: One construction method of distributed agriculture search engine under P2P technology is introduced based on the agriculture ontology. Applying Chord method and B-tree algorithm, the mass data storage and efficiency of retrieval and updating is effectively resolved. Tests show that more satisfactory results have been achieved by the application of the method.

articleTitle: Government tourist information resource integration
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: In order to share and integrate the government's travel information among heterogeneous databases, this paper studied the framework of data integration and application services, focus on the formal expression of the integrated information resources, put forward three dimensions of information resources integrated framework and analyze the information applications, come to improve the efficiency of tourist information resources and management services.

articleTitle: The study on college education management based on workflow technology
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Graduate education management system is based on workflow technology and statistical reporting techniques, graduate education, customized business process management and business reporting format to facilitate efficient and highly practical. In recent years, colleges and universities have been expanding graduate enrollment, academic expertise has been further integration and rapid development of new types and more complex business of education and management of the resulting build a scientific and highly efficient platform for the education and management support is particularly important.

articleTitle: The study of adaptive control based on fuzzy PID for laser cutting
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Amazing at the demand of adaptive control in laser cutting, the adaptive control based on fuzzy PID is researched in this paper. A new fuzzy PID control method is designed to achieve adaptive control of laser cutting. In the new method, laser cutting power is considered as constraints, and the fuzzy PID control is introduced. Also, the details of specific control algorithm are explained in this paper. Compared with traditional PID control method, simulation results show that the new fuzzy controller has high efficiency, high control precision, and good robustness. So it can fully meet the purpose of improving the efficiency of laser cutting.

articleTitle: A path planning algorithm for intelligent virtual agent
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: This paper focuses on how to give the intelligent virtual agent (IVA) behaviors with personalized features. It takes full account of the impact of personality and emotion factor on IVA's behavior, and proposes a path planning algorithm influenced by personality parameters - PD* (Personality D*) algorithm, which is improved on the basis of D* algorithm. PD* algorithm set different level of dangerous coefficient which is associated with IVA's personality, and adopts Heuristic search function based on energy to realize path planning with personality characteristic. The algorithm was tested and applied to an IVA in a Smart Home.

articleTitle: New technology and development trends of mineral processing automation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Mineral processing automation technology has become an indispensable element of productivity due to plays an important role in the reduced cost and stable quality. This paper introduced the history of mineral processing automation and new technology in recent years. The application status of process control, optimal control and other advanced methods in mineral processing automation was also introduced, and the development trends of mineral processing automation were summarized.

articleTitle: The servocontrol technique about multi-axes in-phase & multi-locomotion based on controller
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Based on intensive study of CAN & TCP/IP protocol, an active atmospheric boundary layer(ABL) simulator for wind tunnel test was developed, the multi-axes in-phase and multi-locomotion control was achieved. The experiment results show that the high controlling precision, fast responses, good performance and stability can be found in this system.

articleTitle: How to use blogs in college English teaching
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: The blog, a new web-based tool, has developed very fast in recent years. Because it can be used as a new assistant means of teaching, it attracts more and more attention in Chinese educational field and is gradually used in college English teaching. This paper explains the necessity and feasibility of using blogs in college English teaching, introduces how to build blog platforms, analyses the functions of blogs in teaching and expounds how to use blogs in college English teaching.

articleTitle: VRP-SDK based virtual mine system and its application
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Virtual reality as a new integrated information technology, whose high-dimensional expression of mass information capacity will fully play its role on the coal mine industry, will greatly impact on mine production management methods and decision-making ideas of mine professional. This paper studies how to apply the virtual reality platform VRP to create virtual mine system suitable for business needs of the coal mines. It introduces the main framework of virtual mine system,the database establishment of coal production technology, modeling of virtual mine scene, and so on. Pang Zhuang Coal Mine Virtual Mine system which is developed by these methods realizes real time display and dynamic simulation of all kinds of geological structure and artificial structures and obtained the preliminary application.

articleTitle: Optimized deployment of naval ship formation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Naval ship formation is one of the main counterwork forms in modern sea battles. Reliability theory is used to study naval ship formation deployment. First, a measure method for the cooperative quality of the shipborne equipments in the formation is given based on the concept of reliability degree. Then an optimized deployment of naval fleet is established with consideration of the cooperative quality of the shipborne equipments, and a solving algorithm based on Genetic Algorithm (GA) model is proposed. The effectiveness of the model is proved with massive simulations.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent streetlight monitoring system based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: This paper presents an intelligent streetlight monitoring system based on STM32. In this system, the microcontroller chip STM32F101C8T6 and wireless transceiver chip CC2500 and CC2591 are used. There is a control center and up to 100 groups of control network in the whole network, and each control network has up to 100 terminal nodes which can detect current, voltage and other information and send these information to the transition points by the RF wireless transceiver module, then the transition points transmit information to the control center through GSM/GPRS networks. The control center will deal with the data so that it can know the situation of each streetlight. According to the result the control center gives orders to each streetlight to control the switch state and illumination of them.

articleTitle: iPhone-based Multi-streaming m-Learning platform
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Today, mobile Learning (mLearning) plays an even more important role in our life because of the rapid development of handheld mobile devices and the third generation wireless networks technologies. This has lead to the development of various platforms for mLearning. Here we introduce the design and implementation of a multi-streaming mLearning platform designed specially for iPhone. This platform is innovative in the following aspects: First, Multi-streaming contains screen, audio, and video, which can be sent by web services according to the bandwidth of the Learner. Second, there are several modules for M-Learners to choose for showing those multi-streaming on their devices. Third we added study note, comments, and questions to increase interactivity among learners.

articleTitle: A fast dynamic algorithm for area target scheduling of remote satellite
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: This paper analysis advantages and disadvantages of traditional methods for area target scheduling of remote satellite, a dynamic algorithm for area target scheduling of remote satellites is proposed. This problem is simplified by splitting area into strips, fast area coverage and overlap is proposed by counting grid in complex polygon. Finally, the algorithm is test availability and validity by different data with different satellite and different area target.

articleTitle: A new fuzzy clustering algorithm of User Transaction
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: A new fuzzy clustering algorithm of User Transaction named MTCM is presented based on the analysis of the drawbacks of traditional methods. Firstly, statistics of the page access frequency and time length is kept in user transaction and map them to the continuous access time attribute value. Then, dimensions of transaction is reduced. Finally, according to the calculation of fuzzy similarity between any two transactions, a fuzzy similarity matrix is got to achieve transaction clustering. This algorithm is proved to have better accuracy, fewer CPU time and better expansibility than others.

articleTitle: Fuzzy strong-precompactness and fuzzy strong-preclosed spaces
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: In this paper, fuzzy strong-precompactness and fuzzy strong-preclosed spaces are introduced in fuzzy topological spaces by means of fuzzy strongly preopen sets and fuzzy strongly preclosed sets. The concepts of fuzzy strong-precompactness and fuzzy strong-preclosed spaces are defined and fuzzy filterbases are used to characterize these concepts.

articleTitle: Applications of Multi- wavelet Noise Reduction Algorithm in the Inertial Navigation Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Due to the limitations of the traditional wavelet noise reduction effects, the principle of multi-wavelet method has been analyzed with the aim to apply it to the signal processing of optical angular velocity sensor so as to suppress the noise disturbance of the optical angular velocity sensor output signal. And at the same time, a comparative study has been made between wavelet and multi-wavelet in their noise reduction performances. The research result shows that multi-wavelet can retain more complete signals while suppressing the noise disturbance, although its requirements for the prior knowledge of senor signal are low.

articleTitle: Testing multinormality based on generalized inverse
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Based on a characterization of multivariate normal distribution and the goodness-of-fit test for uniformity on the surface of a unit sphere, we present a new test for multivariate normal distribution. The new test possesses symmetry which improves on the combination tests based on the center of mass and the moment of inertia. The asymptotic chi-squared distribution of the test statistic is obtained, the test statistic has nice properties and it can be easily computed.

articleTitle: Study on the acquisition accuracy and applicability of the floating car data in urban city
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the technique of floating car, the acquisition accuracy of the floating car data was studied using large amount of collected data, which includes data screening, direction angle, position and spot speed. The research findings define the application scope, which can provide important theoretical instruction to the further data mining and application.

articleTitle: The transformation of instrument air dry device based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: This paper introduces the transformation of instrument air dry device with PLC. Addressing the arising problems in operation of old equipments of some petroleum chemical enterprises, the paper proposes that the appliance of PLC optimize control to achieve the safety, stability, full capacity, high quality in the petroleum chemical enterprises.

articleTitle: A distributed fuzzy logic controller based aptitudinal control for single-link flexible manipulator
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: A distributed fuzzy logic controller structure is designed for the single-link flexible manipulator in the paper, Loading to simulated experimental results that show the single-link flexible manipulator has better controlling-presition, lesser vibration at the tip position and faster response.

articleTitle: The method for inner surface finishing of bend and shaped pipe
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: In view of the tough problem about finishing and ultra-precision machining in inner surface of bend and shaped pipe, this paper proposes one new polishing method and technology, and accordingly develops not only the sphere rotating polishing head connected through the flexible wire which is suit for pipe bore surface finishing but also supporting technological equipment and fixtures. Polishing and micro-machining of chamfering in bent and shaped pipe bore surface are able to be achieved successfully the method, respectively. Therefore, other existing methods are incomparable with the advanced method. Inner interface roughness average (Ra) is chosen as criterion to evaluate the polishing method. As a result, original Ra is 10.3867μm, under the condition of velocity of polishing tool does not vary, Ra is 4.2444μm after 2 min polishing, Ra rate decreases 59.14%. After 4 min polishing, Ra is 3.4902μm, Ra rate decreases 66.40%. After 8 min polishing, Ra is 2.8574μm, Ra rate decreases 72.49%. It fully proves that the new polishing method proposed can efficiently address the problem on finishing and ultra-precision machining in inner surface of bent and shaped pipe.

articleTitle: Distributed rudder control system based on CAN bus
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: In order to change rudder angle of the models in the wind tunnel test, a rudder control system (RCS) based on CAN bus was designed. Through the rudder angle regulating by the feedback of Linearity variable differential transducer (LVDT), the RCS achieves high precision control. We present the makeup, principle, and design of hardware and software of RCS. According to the wind tunnel test, the RCS works well, the control precision achieves the design target as expect and the test data meet the needs.

articleTitle: On the developmental pattern of the mobile newspaper during the integration of the three networks: Taking the development of Hebei mobile news for example
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: As a newly developed communication form, mobile newspaper should follow a distinct developmental pattern during the period of integration of the three networks to achieve longitudinal connection, horizontal integration and cross-domain conformity, should become the supplier of intelligent information based on the content it provides to build public trust.

articleTitle: Neighborhood Clonal Selection Learning Algorithm and its application
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a Neighbourhood Clonal Selection Learning Algorithm(N-Clonalg), which is combined with the idea of artificial immune system and Agent technology. Based on the grid environment, the individuals in N-Clonalg do local and global searching operators. Unlike other artificial immune algorithms, N-Clonalg has three main search operators, i.e. Neighbourhood Clonal Selection, Neighbourhood Competition and Self-learning. Combining the global and local search, N-Clonalg overcomes the phenonmena of premature and slow convergence, and can effectively get the global optimals. Distillation resources optimization shows that it has better search performance.

articleTitle: The intelligent dispatching algorithm and implementation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: This article from the bus dispatching existing manual scheduling on the experience to determine the running program of the current situation, on the bus to static scheduling algorithm was studied and improved. Improve the operation efficiency of public transportation vehicle.

articleTitle: Comprehensive service system for digital community design based on web GIS
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Digital community is the community in which manager, service and every resident linked by digital technology. In order to successfully realize digital community, a digital community integrated service system based on was presented and technical line, general design, function design and crucial technology included in this system were discussed. This essay combined technology, spatial database technology, and address coding and matching technology. This system's realization shows that the research of digital community construction is important for our country to develop digital city and achieve modern cities' substantial development.

articleTitle: Fuzzy strongly generalized semi-closed sets in fuzzy topological spaces
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce the concept of fuzzy strongly generalized semi-closed sets in fuzzy topological spaces, which properly lies between the class of fuzzy semi-closed sets and the class of fuzzy generalized semi-closed, and investigate their properties. As applications to fuzzy strongly generalized semi-closed sets, we introduce fuzzy spaces with new kinds of separation axioms and characterize them.

articleTitle: A design of simple serial communication protocol based on the wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Based on the wireless sensor network, a simple serial communication protocol is designed in this paper. This design is based on a wireless sensor network composed of many sensor modules buried under the highway pavement, monitoring stations beside the road and center controller. It can realize measurement data transmitting and receiving between center controller and many different sensor modules. It was proved by test that the design is reliable and effective.

articleTitle: Connection management optimization method based on network dataflow locality
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Targeting the performance requirements of connection management in high-speed networks, an optimization of connection management is proposed, applying Move to Front (MTF) heuristic to improve the lookup operation of connection table. The locality property of network traffic is analyzed, which is represented as a group of packets within a connection probably arrive in group in a short time. Based on the property, the MTF heuristic is applied to optimize the lookup operation of connection table, and get the MTF connection table. The implementation of optimized connection management is described. The optimization of MTF connection table is evaluated via physical high-speed network traffic. Experimental results indicate that the lookup performance of MTF connection table is superior to that of the traditional sorted connection table.

articleTitle: An energy efficient routing protocol in wireless sensor network for health monitoring
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Wireless monitoring systems are increasingly being used in structural health monitoring for its benefits of good economy and ease of maintenance. However, the energy limited of wireless sensor nodes is a major problem for wireless monitoring systems. In this paper, a low-power routing protocol is proposed for the wireless bridge health monitoring system, and the protocol has a good effect on extending the network lifetime. Simulation results show that the protocol balances the network energy consumption, and extends the network lifetime by 30% or more compared with Leach and GAF.

articleTitle: Aviation cargo handling process simulation analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: With the Domestic and foreign situation analyzing, make sure the shortages with the aviation freight, through the automated simulation of loading and unloading of the port, using the software DELMIA to simulate and analyze the loading and unloading of the air cargo. Researching the process of simulation of air cargo transportation from visualization, spatial accessibility and the analysis of the posture and efficiency assessment and optimization to analyze and simulate the process of the air cargo loading and unloading. The process of the simulation finished well with an expected result.

Author Keywords: the loading and unloading of the air cargo

articleTitle: A new form of Z-compactness in L-topological spaces
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: By means of Z-open L-sets and their inequality, a new form of Z-compactness is introduced in L-topological spaces, where L is a complete De Morgan algebra. This new form does not depend on the structure of basis lattice L and L does not require any distributivity. When L is a completely distributive De Morgan algebra, its many characterizations are presented.

articleTitle: The stability analysis and simulation of linear systems via LMI
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: By inequality analysis, this paper deals with the stability of linear system. First of all, by constructing suitable Lyapunov functionals, a new simple sufficient condition is presented for the linear system based on LMI. Next, the sufficient condition of the state feedback system will be given, and the problem of determining the maximum time-delay under which the system will remain stable is cast into a generalized eigenvalue problem solved by LMI toolbox in MATLAB. Finally, two illustrative examples are given to demonstrate the effectiveness and convenience of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Achieving QoS target via adaptive admission control strategy in channelized system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Admission Control between wirelesses networks, such as cellular networks or WLAN (Wireless Local Area Network), plays an important role to utilize radio resources in a more efficient way. In this paper, we propose an adaptive admission control scheme for the channelized networks in terms of connection-level QoS (Quality of Service). The contributions of our work are threefold. First, by using network queuing theory, our scheme is presented and analyzed based on multidimensional Markov chain. Second, to meet the high QoS requirements of different services and lower the blocking probability, certain services can be transformed between real-time wide-band services and non-real-time narrow-band services as necessary. Meanwhile, other strategies, such as pre-emptive priority, are also introduced to further ensure the quality of service of high-priority users and services. Simulation results are also provided for demonstrating that the proposed scheme can improve the system performance compared with existing schemes.

articleTitle: 3D model registration using CSIFT and POSIT
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: This paper describes a novel 3D model registration framework based on Canny edges, CSIFT key points, and Posit algorithm. First, we extract the Canny edges of the 3D model frame and camera frame, further handled by the Fast Fourier Transform, eliminating the impact of the pose differences. Then we use the particle filter to get the optimal position. Then we extract the CSIFT points using color invariant image instead of the gray image, retaining the color invariance and geometric invariance. K-d tree and Ransac algorithms are used to match the key points, which are used by POSIT algorithm to adjust model pose. Finally, we use a cup with different appearance to test the algorithm. The evaluation results support the potential of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of dual-factor authentication file encryption system based on smart-phone
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Designed and implemented a dual-factor authentication file encryption system based on smart-phone, analyzed the security of file encryption system and combined dual-factor authentication technology. Via the mutual approval between Bluetooth as well as application-specific communication protocol and the computer, the system used the smart-phone as a hardware encryption key to set up a file cabinet in the computer for storing private files to deal with the security of information storage. The application shown that the system is easy to use, highly expansible and has greatly improved the security of the data storage.

articleTitle: Design of a new high performance storage method
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: In order to solve the single point failure and performance bottleneck of service in classic storage system, a new storage method IND is proposed in this paper, which is consisted of lots of isomorphic embedded units, a distributed architecture is adopted, in control of virtual techniques the system is just like a union logic unit. It provides user an efficient, scalability and intelligence data storage service. Then a high-performance I/O mechanism depending on the copy mechanism is designed, which stores the copy of hot read-only date in a region of programmable NIC's memory and is managed by IND host to reduce the transfer hot read-only data Experiments show IND system is an efficient storage method which overcomes single-point failure and performance bottleneck and the copy mechanism brings IND system better I/O performance. It is a promising storage strategy.

articleTitle: The quadratic variation of brownian motion and its properties
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: In order to research the quadratic variation better which widely used in Itô Formula and stochastic integral, the convergence of quadratic variation for classical function and Brownian motion has been proved in turn. By introducing Brownian motion and using its properties the quadratic variation of Brownian motion can be estimated. Based on the above comparisons and analyses, a dramatically different result is obtained.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of the robot-fish simulation system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: The simulation system design is proposed for global vision robot-fish and autonomous robot-fish, to satisfy the actual need of underwater bionic robot-fish research and the robot-fish water-polo-game. The system design is put forward originally that concludes a semi-physical simulation model with a 3 layer structure and 2 UDP/IP communications. The simulation system uses the architecture of Client/Server and the centralization simulation model combined with distribution simulation model on the base of the Microsoft Robotics Developer Studio (MRDS), and has irreplaceable advantages, especially for the development of underwater multi-robot-fish cooperation.

articleTitle: Simulation and implementation of MSK BPTC code in DSP chips
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: This study discussed the decoding mechanism of block product turbo code (BPTC) (196,96) and simulated its efficiency, used the Hamming (15,11) and Hamming (13,9) block channel code combinations and block interleaving to construct a MSK modulation and BPTC (196,96) coding system in the concept of feedback encoding in turbo code. The decoding mechanism was meticulously described to explain the advantage of this turbo feedback structure. This study also analyzed and simulated special combination of MSK modulation with BPTC channel code. The simulation results indicate MSK BPTC is less robust than MSK Golay (20, 8) of t = 4 for 1.2dB against noise, but having better performance when the signal Eb/N0 exceeding the cross over point and approaching 0.2dB gain relative to MSK Golay (20, 8) of t = 4. Whenever the C code system program is constructed, the system program should be optimized and realized on the DSP platform. Both MSK BPTC and BPSK BPTC C program optimization efficiency statistics are analyzed. The implementation can be applied to the wireless communication system of Software Defined Radio (SDR) concept, so that different modulation and encoding modes can adjust parameters in firmware directly according to different system specification requirements.

articleTitle: The application of doubly fed vector control strategy in pump motor
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: In this paper, a new variable speed system applied in pump motor is proposed. The mathematical model of wound-rotor asynchronous motor under M-T coordinate system is deduced, and control strategy of doubly fed motor excitation based on stator flux oriented vector control technology and power relationship at three operating states are demonstrated. The satisfactory experimental results are attained when applying this strategy in inverter connecting bump motor rotor and power grid.

articleTitle: The design and exploitation of personalized recommendation system based on Multi-Agent Collaboration system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Aiming at the deficiencies of existing recommendation system, this paper introduces the personalized recommendation system, Agent and MAS system, proposes a Exploitation model of personalized recommendation system based on Multi-Agent Collaboration system, works out the principle of the model, and discusses the key technologies used in the model.

articleTitle: Study of the operator model for robotic excavation
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Improving the intelligent ability of a robotic excavator is useful in practice, and this is a challengeable work due to the complex working environment of robotic excavation. In order to increase the performance of automatic control, operator model of robotic excavation derive from excavator driver is established to overcome the complex nonlinearities of the control system. The model is accordant with the operation properties of the excavator that it improves the autonomous ability of the robotic excavator. The operator model of robotic excavation based on neural network theory is developed in this paper. The experiment results demonstrate that this operator model is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: An optimized design for the test case of web application
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: In order to design an optimized test case to test web application, a method of equivalence partitioning is used in this paper. Based on the evaluation of equivalence classes for the input condition, the web application of the Accela GIS module is divided into seven partitions, and the twelve vital test cases are designed. The results of test show that the process of executing the test program can find errors, and in particular, the test cases have the high probability of finding as-yet-undiscovered errors. These test cases can basically cover all of the test points and be repeated less. The equivalence partitioning is effectively designed into test cases of the web application, which are feasible, strong and easy to be understood, to reduce the total number of test cases that must be developed.

articleTitle: Variable step-size blind source separation algorithm based on orthogonal gradient
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: Combined with natural gradient algorithm and FASTICA method, orthogonal algorithm was proposed for blind source separation. the algorithm by using the natural gradient algorithm iterative form and independent component analysis orthogonalization process, realizes the separation matrix in orthogonal space search. At the same time, the design of a new variable step size algorithm, which makes the step size in the iterative process of adaptive regulation, to further improve the performance of the algorithm. The simulation results prove that, variable step orthogonal gradient algorithm and the natural gradient algorithm and FASTICA algorithm, has better convergence speed and convergence performance.

articleTitle: Research of time-frequency synchronization in MIMO-OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: A time-frequency synchronization scheme and a kind of multi-input multi-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing(MIMO-OFDM) training sequency are proposed from the point of time-frequency joint-design. The time synchronization is accomplished by the symmetric conjugate of the training sequence in time domain, and the frequency synchronization is finished by the good autocorrelation of the training symbol in frequency domain. Comparing with the conventional schemes, this proposed scheme gives very accurate estimates of symbol timing and carrier frequency offset, and provides a very wide acquisition range for the carrier frequency offset, up to (−N/2, N/2) theoretically. The simulation results show that comparing with the conventional schemes, under multipath fading channels, this scheme has higher timing offset estimation precision, particularly obviously when the signal to noise ratio (SNR) is small, and while frequency offset estimation mean square error (MSE) is 1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−4</sup>, approximately 3 dB can be improved.

articleTitle: OBTS-oriented research on warship main power system hybrid model
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: This paper puts forward a warship main power on board training system hybrid modeling method based on neural network and integrates the method of mechanism modeling and Identification Modeling, uses neural network to compensate the error from the mechanism model. It improves the model precision, and suit the behavior changing of main power system. Taking warship diesel as an example, the developing method of hybrid model of diesel rotating speed was studied, and the feasibility of hybrid modeling method proposed was testified.

articleTitle: Numerical study of spectral properties of ultrashort hyperbolic secant pulsed beams
publicationTitle: 2012 IEEE Symposium on Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEESYM)
abstract: The spectral properties of the ultrashort hyperbolic secant pulsed beam are studied in free space. The analytic expression of power spectrum of the ultrashort hyperbolic secant pulsed beam and some numerical calculations are given.
